---
name: plan-study
description: Plan a synthetic study and stop at an explicit approval gate before interviews run.
---
# Plan study
- Read candidate persona calibration statuses and disclose them in the plan.
- Create a new study from `studies/_template/`.
- Write `question.md`, private `hypotheses.md`, and `protocol.md` with `status: draft`.
- Use 6-10 core questions: behavior first, attitudes next, hypotheticals last. Keep wording neutral; include follow-ups and at least one contradiction/workaround probe.
- Specify personas, rationale, runs per persona (default 3), framing per run, transcript naming and what real research would add.
- Stop after presenting the plan. Do not change protocol status to approved or run interviews until the user explicitly approves.
- Report persona statuses, planned interview-turn count and the question with the greatest uncertainty.
